baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins saying at index 1, believing at indices 2 and 15, obeying at index 5, and turning away at index 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken claim to settled assent and enacted submission is followed by a later act of withdrawal; the closing denial classifies the claim by the sequence it produces rather than by its wording alone.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies outwardly articulated speech and makes the opening a publicly inspectable declaration.
The branch supplies assent in which the heart settles, linking the claimed act to the denied believer-status.
The branch supplies yielding that proceeds with an order, so obedience is an enacted trajectory rather than another proposition.
The branch supplies withdrawal and refusal of proximity, functionally reversing the claimed submission.
The branch supplies a later phase following the declaration, making the contradiction sequential and observable.

changed_reading.before: They make a faith claim but later disobey.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a failed speech-act: later withdrawal supplies the behavioral verdict on the earlier claim of heart-settled assent and submission.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The belief, messenger, obedience, and turning roots at indices 2-7 form a relational chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith establishes trusted security, the messenger carries the binding communication, and obedience is concord with it; turning away changes the relation from attachment and support into withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies security and trust, rendering faith as a stable relational condition.
The branch supplies a messenger and carried message, locating trust in a mediated relation with practical claims.
The branch supplies concord between parties, making obedience a maintained alignment.
The branch supplies alliance, support, and attachment as the positive relation placed at risk.
The branch supplies active withdrawal, converting claimed allegiance into relational abandonment.

changed_reading.before: The group fails to carry out a command.
changed_reading.after: The group withdraws the trust, concord, and allegiance that its formula had claimed, so the failure is relational before it is merely episodic.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The faction noun at index 8 is qualified as being from among the speakers and follows the turning verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: A piece separates from within the claim-making collective. The ayah therefore distinguishes the withdrawing subset without treating every speaker as an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: The branch allows saying to denote a professed position, supplying the collective stance from which a subset separates.
The branch supplies a group as a separated piece, making internal cleavage the social shape of the withdrawal.
The branch supplies the act of turning away that produces the factional separation.
The branch supplies distance from prior proximity, spatializing the subset's departure from its own professed position.

changed_reading.before: Some individuals among them are hypocritical.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts an internal collective fracture: a professing body generates a detached faction through its own act of withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent unit places the faction before an adjudicative summons: it turns aside from judgment yet comes submissively when the possessed right favors it. True believer-speech adds receptive hearing to obedience, while emphatic oaths are displaced by recognizable action. The focus claim is therefore exposed as outcome-contingent allegiance to judgment.

activation_trace.role: Spoken articulation supplies the focal profession whose practical value the following summons tests.
Yielding to an order supplies the claimed conduct tested under an unfavorable decision.
Withdrawal supplies the focal response that the adjudicative context specifies.
Judgment between people supplies the concrete institutional setting in which claimed obedience is tried.
Turning one's side away supplies an embodied refusal parallel to the focal withdrawal.
A right possessed by its owner supplies the favorable stake that switches the faction into compliance.
Submissive yielding supplies the group's contrasting readiness when the outcome benefits it.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive step missing from the focal formula.
Enacted yielding supplies the normative believer-response to the same summons.
Sworn assurance supplies intensified speech whose force is explicitly set below recognizable obedience.
Intended action supplies the observable domain against which declarations and oaths are known.

structural_cues: 24:48-51 directly repeats Allah, messenger, faction, saying, believing, and obeying around a summons to judgment.
The condition in 24:49 correlates their submissive arrival with the right being theirs.
24:53-54 contrast strenuous oath-speech with known obedience and distributed responsibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjudication, refusal, favorable-right submission, receptive hearing, oath, and action; I infer that expected outcome controls the faction's compliance. A live alternative is generalized reluctance rather than deliberate forum selection.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are generally insincere or inconsistent.
changed_reading.after: They profess obedience while treating divine-prophetic judgment as optional when it threatens their interest; the ayah diagnoses selective legal allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech moves through a mutually supporting group, is received tongue-to-tongue without knowledge, and is later answered by bodily testimony to action. That ecology makes the focal profession neither private nor self-validating: words acquire standing only when knowledge, conduct, and embodied evidence support them.

activation_trace.role: Outward speech supplies the focal evidence-claim that requires corroboration.
Heart-settled assent supplies the inner status asserted by speech and denied after conduct is observed.
Behavioral withdrawal supplies the counter-evidence to the profession.
Speech diverted from truth supplies the surah's explicit case of words failing truthful reference.
A mutually supporting group supplies the social machinery by which speech becomes coordinated rather than merely individual.
Taking charge of a matter supplies leadership within the harmful speech network and sharpens the focal factional mechanism.
Receiving and passing on words supplies the transmission link in the speech chain.
The tongue as speech-organ supplies the bodily channel through which unsupported claims circulate.
A saying spread among people supplies the public circulation that makes verbal conduct consequential.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the absent epistemic support against which the circulating words fail.
Testimony that states what is known supplies the formal audit of professed identity.
Hands as bearers of what they acquired supply action as evidence that can answer speech.
Purposeful deeds supply the record by which the verbal profession is tested.

structural_cues: 24:4-25 repeatedly distinguishes allegation, testimony, knowledge, falsehood, and deed.
24:11 and 24:47 both locate consequential failure inside a subgroup from among the community.
The tongue that transmits unsupported speech in 24:15 becomes a witness alongside hands and feet in 24:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech network, lack of knowledge, formal testimony, and deeds; I infer that the focus's closing denial functions like an evidentiary classification from speech-action mismatch. The live alternative is a purely moral sincerity judgment without forensic coloring.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts what people say with what they do.
changed_reading.after: The profession is a public claim under evidentiary audit: coordinated speech cannot establish believer-status when embodied conduct testifies against it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light and guidance sequence culminates immediately before the focus in clear signs and guidance to a straight path. The focal turning root then becomes directional: the failure is not lack of verbal recognition but reversal of orientation after a route has been disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Turning the face and directing oneself supplies the positive orientation that could have followed the disclosed path.
Turning away supplies the enacted reversal of that possible orientation.
A later phase supplies the temporal fact that reversal follows rather than precedes disclosure and profession.
Illumination supplies the extended visibility field in which orientation can be tested.
Gentle indication toward a path and truth supplies directional guidance rather than mere information.
Guidance toward the way supplies the immediate lead-in to the focal reversal.
The straight road supplies the trajectory from which turning away deviates.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the path's stable geometry, opposed by the faction's turn.

structural_cues: 24:35-46 develops illumination, lack of light, sight, signs, guidance, and movement.
24:46 is the immediate syntactic-contextual threshold before the profession and turn in 24:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, guidance, a straight path, and the focal turning construction; I infer that moral refusal is rendered as directional reversal. The live alternative is that the path language remains general background while 24:48-50 provides the controlling legal specification.

changed_reading.before: They know the message but refuse obedience.
changed_reading.after: They verbally identify with guidance yet bodily reorient away from an already illuminated straight course; profession without sustained direction does not constitute faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later the surah defines believers as those who do not leave a gathering matter without permission, then depicts people extracting themselves secretly under others' cover and opposing the command. This recasts the focal faction's turn as an unauthorized social exit that converts a gathered whole into a separated piece.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the focal status whose social enactment the later definition makes explicit.
A separated group supplies the social result produced when members withdraw from the whole.
Withdrawal supplies the focal departure that the later permission protocol sharpens.
Settled belief supplies the explicit identity assigned to those who remain responsibly engaged.
Joining dispersed parts into a whole supplies the collective matter from which departure has consequences.
Going away supplies the concrete departure whose legitimacy depends on permission.
Authorization supplies the relational procedure that distinguishes accountable departure from evasion.
Gentle hidden extraction supplies the stealth mechanism by which members remove themselves.
Concealment behind another supplies social cover for the unauthorized exit.
Taking a path different from another's supplies active opposition rather than neutral absence.
A binding request supplies the norm against which the hidden departure becomes disobedience.

structural_cues: 24:62 explicitly defines believers through conduct while together on a collective matter.
24:63 follows with covert departure under cover and opposition to the messenger's command.
The focus faction and the later gathered matter form inverse group geometries: separation versus responsible cohesion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a believer-definition, collective matter, permission, hidden extraction, cover, and opposition; I infer that the focal turn can denote socially evasive disengagement, not only inward apostasy. The live alternative is that 24:62-63 regulates a distinct physical departure and only analogically illuminates 24:47.

changed_reading.before: A faction mentally or morally turns away after professing belief.
changed_reading.after: The faction enacts nonbelief by peeling away from shared obligation without accountable leave, using withdrawal itself to fracture the believing collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise couples the same root with both belief and security, requires fitting action, and then marks disbelief after that as an exit. This makes the focus's later-after formula carry the weight of reversal after claimed settledness or received security, not merely a change of mood.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust supply the stable condition claimed at the focus and denied after withdrawal.
The later phase supplies the focal marker that makes breach subsequent to commitment.
Withdrawal supplies the act that breaks the claimed settled relation.
The shared branch spans professed faith and replacement of fear by security, joining conviction to a protected social condition.
Purposeful action supplies the expected continuation of belief rather than a detachable supplement.
One condition replacing another supplies the promised movement from fear into security.
The repeated later-after relation supplies a close temporal echo to the focus's post-declaration reversal.
Covering a benefit supplies ingratitude as a breach after security rather than ignorance before it.
A moist fruit slipping out of its covering supplies a material image of exit from the containing commitment.

structural_cues: 24:55 uses the security and belief senses of one root in the same promise.
Both 24:47 and 24:55 mark a disqualifying reversal with an after-that sequence.
In 24:55 belief is coupled to fitting deeds and a communal change from fear to security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, action, security replacing fear, and disbelief after that; I infer that the focus's temporal reversal is aggravated by prior commitment or benefit. The live alternative is that the promise addresses a wider community and does not identify what the focal speakers had received.

changed_reading.before: They change course sometime after making a statement.
changed_reading.after: Their turn is a post-commitment breach: claimed trust should settle into action and security, but the faction exits after presenting itself as already inside that relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus obedience root and joins it to cross-domain light and lightning material. It remains anchored at focus index 5 and is sharpened by the immediate illumination sequence and a packet branch for a flash without realization. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material echo, never as the translation of the obedience verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus obedience verb at index 5 is read through its packet-supplied secondary mapping, while the turn at index 7 tests whether its manifestation persists.

activation_trace.role: Rising and extending visibility supplies an exploratory image of obedience becoming manifest rather than remaining verbal.
Withdrawal supplies the interruption that prevents the professed manifestation from becoming sustained direction.
Illumination supplies the contextual field in which a manifest claim can either endure or fail.
Lightning brightness supplies the brief visible flare used to model emphatic but transient profession.
A false gleam lacking realization supplies the exact caution: visible signal need not have enacted substance.

changed_reading.before: They verbally claim obedience and then abandon it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their claimed obedience flares as visible profession but never becomes sustained illumination or direction; the turn reveals signal without realization.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the obedience root's pasture-and-fruit readiness branch as a material analogy. It remains anchored in the focal obedience claim and gains contextual control from the faction's submissiveness only when its own right is ready to receive. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image of availability and tractability, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus obedience claim at index 5 is tested against the subsequent withdrawal at index 7.

activation_trace.role: Pasture or fruit becoming ready and available supplies a material model of the self made available to an order.
Withdrawal supplies the refusal of that availability once the claim faces a real demand.
A right possessed by its owner supplies the benefit that makes the faction selectively ready.
Submissive yielding supplies the observed tractability when that benefit is available.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is a binary declaration followed by refusal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, true obedience is readiness made available to the command, whereas this faction becomes tractable only when its own benefit is ripe.

strongest_changes: The immediate adjudication sequence turns generic inconsistency into outcome-contingent legal allegiance.
The surah's speech and testimony network makes believer-status an embodied evidentiary judgment, not a self-certifying declaration.
The later permission sequence recasts the faction's turn as an unauthorized exit that fractures a collective matter.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one compact profession answerable across legal procedure, speech transmission, bodily evidence, illuminated direction, collective permission, and post-security obligation while preserving the focus roots as anchors.
remaining_uncertainties: The directional light reading may be secondary to the explicit adjudicative explanation in 24:48-50.
The unauthorized-exit model is a strong structural analogy but may describe a later distinct situation rather than the same actors.
The two outliers depend on material or split-root branches and should remain exploratory rather than control the rendering.
